usageNotes: Use this to update an existing SDN DNS provider object (e.g. PowerDNS) in the cluster SDN configuration. Requires the `SDN.Allocate` privilege on `/sdn/dns`. After updating, you must apply the pending SDN configuration via `put_cluster_sdn` for the changes to take effect on nodes.

examples.summary: Update the API URL and TTL for an existing PowerDNS SDN integration

tips: Pass `digest` (from the corresponding GET) to guard against concurrent modifications — the API will reject the write if another change has been committed since you read the config.
Use the `delete` param to unset optional fields (e.g. `fingerprint`) rather than leaving stale values; value is a comma-separated list of config key names.
The `fingerprint` field (SHA-256, colon-separated hex pairs) is required when the DNS provider uses a self-signed TLS certificate and you want Proxmox to validate it.
Changes are staged — they do not propagate to SDN-capable nodes until you call the apply endpoint (`put_cluster_sdn`).
